summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026 (event date November 5, 2026) furnishing a press release and two presentations (conference and investor) under Items 8.01 and 9.01. The disclosure concerns incremental Phase 1/2a data for [212Pb]Bamzireotide Navoxetan (VMT-α-NET) in SSTR2-expressing neuroendocrine tumors, presented at the NANETS 2026 symposium (November 5-7, Las Vegas); the company cites durable disease control and a planned End-of-Phase 2 meeting in 1Q 2027. No transaction, consideration, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory clock terms are stated. What to watch: clinical/regulatory progression, not deal arbitrage.
